full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white fashion photograph shows a solitary model in a dark tailored suit standing against a plain wall crossed by broad diagonal bands of light. The wall occupies the entire background, turning bright at the upper left and dimmer toward the lower corners. A sharp-edged luminous stripe angles from the left side behind the model toward the right, while softer shadow bands travel parallel across the wall. Near the center, the model stands with shoulders angled slightly and head tipped downward. Tousled short hair falls over the forehead and partly conceals the eyes, leaving the pale bridge of the nose, cheek, and lips visible in a narrow wash of light. The expression is reserved, and the downward gaze keeps the figure inward-looking rather than confrontational. A broad dark jacket sits over a buttoned vest and high dark neckline, creating stacked planes of charcoal and black; both hands rest inside the trouser pockets. The trousers and lower jacket run into the nearly black lower edge, so the frame presents the body from the head to about mid-thigh without showing feet. The wall shadow behind the shoulder repeats the body's outline as a broad curved dark shape, distinct from the straighter architectural light bands. Hard directional light from the upper left cuts across the background and glances over the face, while the jacket absorbs most of it; this produces bright gray wall areas, a small facial highlight, and deep suit shadows. Fine photographic grain and slight softness in the wall give the image a tactile printed quality, although the suit silhouette and main light boundary remain firm. The overall composition uses a restrained tonal scale and off-center standing form to set quiet personal presence against dramatic diagonal geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白时装摄影描绘一名孤身模特穿深色合身西装，站在被宽阔斜向光带穿过的素墙前。墙面占满整个背景，左上方明亮，向下方两角逐渐变暗。一条边缘鲜明的亮带从模特身后的左侧斜向右侧，较柔和的暗带则平行掠过墙面。靠近中央，模特肩部略带倾角，头向下低垂。凌乱短发落在额前，部分遮住双眼，浅色鼻梁、面颊和嘴唇露在一道狭窄的光中。神情克制，下垂的目光使人物显得内省而非与观者对峙。宽肩深色外套罩在扣好的马甲与深色高领之上，形成炭灰到黑色的叠合平面；双手都放在裤袋中。长裤和外套下部融入近黑色的画面底边，因此画幅呈现从头到大腿中段的人体，没有露出脚。肩后墙上的投影以宽阔弧状暗形重复身体轮廓，有别于更直的空间光带。来自左上的强方向光切过背景并擦亮面部，外套却吸收了大部分光；于是墙面呈明灰色，脸上只有小片亮部，西装暗部深沉。细微摄影颗粒和墙面的轻微柔化给画面印刷般触感，西装剪影与主要光边仍然坚定。整体构图以克制的明度范围和稍偏中心的站立形体，把安静的个人存在置于戏剧性的斜向几何之中。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photograph makes hard directional light and broad shadow geometry its primary structure. A fine-grained gray surface shifts from luminous silver to velvety black, with highlights confined to narrow exposed areas and large dark shapes retaining readable contours. Diagonal bands cross a simple background, setting a measured rhythm behind a compact, nearly black focal mass. Some boundaries are sharply cut by light, while smaller transitions remain soft and slightly printed, so the image carries both graphic force and photographic texture. The darkest values merge near the bottom, and the brightest region opens above and to one side, lending vertical depth without additional decoration. The overall treatment is spare, moody, and editorial, with light placement doing more work than surface ornament.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅黑白摄影把强方向光与宽阔阴影几何作为主要结构。带细颗粒的灰阶表面从发亮银灰过渡到丝绒般黑色，高光限制在窄小的受光区域，大块暗形仍保持可辨轮廓。斜向带纹穿过简单背景，在紧凑的近黑色焦点块后形成有分寸的节奏。有些边界被光切得锐利，较小的过渡则柔和并略带印刷质感，因此图像兼具图形力量和摄影纹理。最暗明度在下方合并，最亮区域则向偏上一侧敞开，不靠多余装饰便形成竖向深度。整体处理简洁、阴郁且具有编辑摄影气质，光位比表面装饰承担更多作用。
theme_en: A solitary model in a dark tailored suit beneath diagonal bands of light
theme_zh: 孤身模特穿深色合身西装，置于斜向光带之下
name: David Sims
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
